candidates: When adding custom props to a component that wraps an HTML input element (or any component inheriting `HTMLProps<HTMLInputElement>` / `ComponentProps<'input'>`) that forwards remaining props via a `...props` spread, avoid naming custom props after native HTML attributes (e.g. `step`, `min`, `max`, `pattern`). A name collision silently swallows the native attribute — callers who pass it expecting DOM forwarding will find it never reaches the element. Use a descriptive, intent-revealing prefix to disambiguate (e.g. `keyboardStep` instead of `step` for a prop that controls arrow-key increment behavior).
